crew.overview: Loosely based on the true-life tale of Ron Woodroof, a drug-taking, women-loving, homophobic man who in 1986 was diagnosed with HIV/AIDS and given thirty days to live.
crew.title: Dallas Buyers Club

details.biography:
Rachel Winter is a film producer. Winter and her fellow producers were nominated for an Academy Award for Best Picture for the 2013 film Dallas Buyers Club. In 2015, she co-founded RainMaker Films with producers Clay Pecorin, Russell Geyser, Chris Robert, and Corey DeSalvo. RainMaker, which is producing and/or financing multiple projects, recently expanded its repertoire and bolstered project development across various genres, including suspense, fantasy, and sci-fi material.
